visual_action: A wide shot shows the musician Lady Gaga on a stage at night, in front of a city skyline. In the sky behind her, hundreds of illuminated drones form red, white, and blue patterns. She speaks into a microphone, wearing a sparkly silver outfit, and then raises her arms as if in celebration before the clip ends.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: The on-screen text describes the event as 'the Kamala Harris rally'.

on_screen_text.text: POV: me watching Lady Gaga tonight at the Kamala Harris rally 🇺🇸📣

spoken_summary: Lady Gaga is heard reciting the end of the Pledge of Allegiance: '...one nation, under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all.'
audio_music: The audio is from a live performance by Lady Gaga, fingerprinted as her rendition of 'God Bless America'. The clip features her speaking patriotically over a quiet, reverent musical backing that creates a grand and patriotic atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static wide shot.
central_claim: Lady Gaga's spectacular and patriotic performance at a Kamala Harris rally associates the candidate with celebrity support and national pride.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel patriotic pride and excitement, associating those positive feelings with Kamala Harris's campaign.
